name: Realism Mod Compatibility
description:
DEPENDENCIES

-> SPT Realism Mod 1.6.4

FEATURES

Balances armor classes, durabilities, damage, penetration, and other ballistic qualities to play well with my other mods. This is by no means an improvement on the REALISM aspect, rather a deliberate tweak to add purpose to many otherwise useless items and further spread the strength of items along the value and rarity spectrum.

dependencies.name: SPT Realism Mod
dependencies.teaser: Realistic Overhaul of SPT designed around making the game experience as realistic and hardcore as possible. Highly configurable!

versions.description:
SPT Realism Mod v1.6.4 for SPT 3.11

Note: please see the “known issues” section at the bottom of this post before reporting issues.

Changes:

  • Added config option for stance SFX volume

Fixes:

  • Fixed loud sound effect when transitioning stances

Known Issues:

  • Balancing is always on-going.
  • Continuous healing is not compatible with the medical system, recommended to disable it.
  • Using limb selector to heal (hotkey + scroll) can cause strange animation issues and potentially bugs.
  • Glock 18C recoil is bugged, BSG issue.
  • High ready sprint animation bugs out sometimes, BSG issue (haven’t seen it happen in 3.11 yet).
  • Can hit self with melee in the legs.
  • SPT/EFT is cursed.

SPT Realism Mod v1.6.3 for SPT 3.11

Note: please see the “known issues” section at the bottom of this post before reporting issues.

Changes:

  • Aiming Overhaul: if using FOV Fix v3.1.4 and stances are enabled, aiming is very smooth, no jank. This is done by having the sights move to the player camera, instead of the camera move to the sights. Stances were adjusted, including config options, please make sure to reset the config options for weapon and stance position/rotation offsets and speeds if you have modified them.
  • Pistol Recoil Rework: pistol rework has been modified to increase visual muzzle flip and to prevent recoil from patterning downwards when firing quickly.
  • Recoil Bloom: weapon’s have increased spread when firing in full auto beyond short bursts. This is based on the weapon’s dispersion stat, give this stat more importance for certain playstyles. Overheating is also a factor.
  • Added more recoil config options specific to pistols. Redid some of the default values.
  • Added heartbeat SFX when player has Adrenaline status effect active (thanks ViperWolf263 for the files and Niall for the suggestion).
  • Tweaks to recoil of some weapons and in general

Fixes:

  • Fixed issues with how visual recoil was applied to pistols, fixed some edge cases. Reworked how it’s calculated.
  • Bayonet charge now has sprint SFX.
  • Non-bayonet melee animation is fixed.
  • Fixed recoil dispersion stat not applying to pistols.
  • Fixed and added missing stats for some items and gear.
  • Re-added TGC gas masks to bot pool (only one of them was removed from the mod)

Known Issues:

  • Balancing is always on-going.
  • Continuous healing is not compatible with the medical system, recommended to disable it.
  • Using limb selector to heal (hotkey + scroll) can cause strange animation issues and potentially bugs.

SPT Realism Mod v1.6.0 for SPT 3.11

Note: please see the “known issues” section at the bottom of this post before reporting issues.

A huge thanks to everyone who helped with testing and gave feedback. It would have taken much longer without you

Changes:

  • Recoil Tweaks: changed some of the default recoil config values and tweaked some stats. You will need to reset your recoil config values manually. Some balancing done, more to come.
  • Bayonet Charge: If you have a bayonet equipped, you can hold the rifle melee button to keep the rifle in a rearward prepared state. If the rifle comes into contact with anything it will release and attack. You can sprint in this state, and gain a bonus to damage based on your speed. Is it janky? Yes. Is it fun? Maybe.
  • Improved Healing Out Of Raid: You can now treat radiation and toxicity our of raid using appropriate drugs and stims. Max radiation is now treatable out of raid at a reduced rate with meds if Med Station is at level 3. Surgery kits can heal HP out of raid.
  • Stance rotation/position options are now displayed as Vector3. This means all your tweaks to them are reset, but also means way fewer options cluttering the menu.
  • Pistol ADS is now very smooth when using alt pistol position + latest FOV Fix v1.3.3.
  • Rebalanced loot in Hazard Zones: overall spawn chance of radiological and radiation samples are much higher, dynamic zones now have 100% loot chance. Quality of loot varies instead.
  • Bot spawns have more randomization to Scav and PMC spawns. Some raids might be quiet, some may be busy. Bots will stop spawning after raid start most of the time.
  • Added 2 new Hazard Zones to Customs to go with the expansion. More to come.

Fixes:

  • Fixed spawning in hazards, should also prevent bots from doing so.
  • Fixed various minor issues and bugs.

Known Issues:

  • Balancing is always on-going.
  • Continuous healing is not compatible with the medical system, recommended to disable it.
  • Using limb selector to heal (hotkey + scroll) can cause strange animation issues and potentially bugs.

  • Can hit self with melee in the legs.
  • SPT/EFT is cursed.
